content:
Fernando discussed his Pokémon 3D Mod on Mac, and Jeff shared his experience running a native port of Mario Kart 64 on iPhone. The group also discussed why tech products feel less exciting than they used to, and shared their views on long-term use of the same device.

9to5Mac Overtime is a weekly video-focused podcast that explores interesting observations within the Apple ecosystem, hosted by 9to5Mac's Fernando Silva and Jeff Benjamin. Subscribe to Overtime on Apple Podcasts and our YouTube channel for more content.
